question: Compare the FY24 dividend payout ratio of Coca-Cola (KO) to that of its competitors and rank in order from highest to lowest.
model_answer:
**Bottom line (FY24, cash dividends paid ÷ GAAP net income):**

| Rank | Company | FY24 dividends paid | FY24 net income | Payout ratio |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | **Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP)** | $1.194B | $1.441B | **82.9%** |
| 2 | **Coca-Cola (KO)** | $8.359B | $10.631B | **78.6%** |
| 3 | **PepsiCo (PEP)** | $7.229B | $9.578B | **75.5%** |
| 4 | **Monster Beverage (MNST)** | $0 | $1.509B | **0.0%** |

So, highest to lowest: **KDP > KO > PEP > MNST**.

Key takeaways:

- **Coca-Cola’s FY24 payout ratio was about 78.6%**, second-highest in this peer group.
- It was **~4.2 percentage points below KDP** and **~3.1 points above PepsiCo**.
- **KDP’s GAAP payout looks unusually high** because 2024 net income was reduced by $718 million of goodwill/intangible impairments. On KDP’s adjusted net income of $2.632B, the payout would be about **45.4%**, which would rank it below KO and PEP.
- **Monster pays no dividend**, so its payout ratio is 0%.

A DPS/EPS cross-check gives the same ranking: KO **78.5%** ($1.94/$2.47), PEP **76.7%** ($5.33/$6.95), KDP roughly **83–85%**, and MNST **0%**.

Sources: [Coca-Cola FY24 10-K cash flow](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/R7.htm) and [income statement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/R3.htm); [PepsiCo FY24 annual report](https://www.pepsico.com/docs/pepsico-5v9wci20/media/Files/investors/2024-pepsico-annual-report-01.pdf); [KDP FY24 earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1418135/000141813525000011/ex991-keurigdrpepperreport.htm); [Monster FY24 results](https://investors.monsterbevcorp.com/news-releases/news-release-details/monster-beverage-reports-2024-fourth-quarter-and-full-year).
judge_reason: KDP and KO match, but PEP is 75.5% vs 0.75 and KHC/SJM are omitted; contradiction triggered.
